claim: The analytics loaders (analytics.service.ts loadInventory, advanced-analytics.service.ts loadInventoryWithCost, pricing/margin-advice.service.ts adviseHouse and accept) read inventory_lot_agreed_cost and hand has_agreed_cost / agreed_wac to resolveUnitCost, so an item whose only cost is an agreed lot reads as agreed_lot_wac (QA round 20 C; closes the debt filed by RECIPE-READS-AGREED-LOT-COST).
